summary: Order placement 500s are caused by bad deployment dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0, deployed 12:10:00Z) which added a MarginCheckValidator for F&O orders. The new validator dereferences a null marginProfile, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500. Onset is time-locked to the deploy (first error 12:12:31Z; error_rate 0.21% -> 18.3% in the 12:12 bucket) and errors are exclusively orderType=FNO, matching the derivatives-only ticket pattern. Alternatives ruled out: no order-service config change; no downstream/ledger-db errors; CPU/memory/DB pool/request_rate all flat (no saturation or load surge). Recommended: roll back dep-5101 / revert to v2.14.0's predecessor, and add null-safety to MarginCheckValidator.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Bad deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) introduced a NPE in the new MarginCheckValidator for F&O orders
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Deployment dep-5101 at 12:10:00Z added MarginCheckValidator to the order validation chain for F&O orders and removed the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(). The new validator dereferences marginProfile, which is null for F&O accounts, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500. Because only F&O orders take this path, only derivatives order placements fail, giving the sharp ~18% error rate.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Upstream/dependency fault made marginProfile data unavailable
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A dependency (ledger-db or a margin-profile source) stopped serving margin data, so marginProfile is null when order-service validates F&O orders.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: ledger-db shows no errors (only an unrelated TLS cipher warning), no downstream service shows elevated errors, and the onset aligns exactly with dep-5101 rather than any dependency change; a dependency outage would not be perfectly time-locked to an order-service code deploy.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Resource exhaustion / capacity saturation in order-service
ranked_hypotheses.statement: CPU, memory or DB connection pool exhaustion in order-service causes validation failures and 500s.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: CPU ~40%, memory ~60%, db_pool_in_use ~14 and request_rate ~232 req/s are all flat across the onset; the error is a deterministic NPE on FNO orders, not saturation.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service dep-5101 (v2.14.0) to the prior version immediately.
recommended_actions.rationale: Errors are time-locked to this deploy and it is still live with rolled_back_at null; rollback is the fastest mitigation.

recommended_actions.action: Verify error_rate returns to baseline (<1%) after rollback to confirm causality.
recommended_actions.rationale: A clean recovery after rollback confirms the deployment as the fault and rules out coincidental dependency causes.

recommended_actions.action: Add null-safety/guard for marginProfile in MarginCheckValidator and validate the F&O margin path in staging before re-release.
recommended_actions.rationale: The NPE at line 88 on FNO accounts indicates the new validator assumes marginProfile is always non-null.

recommended_actions.action: Add canary/gradual rollout and F&O-order smoke tests gating validation-chain deploys.
recommended_actions.rationale: Deploy caused ~18% failure for F&O orders immediately on full rollout; staged rollout and path-specific tests would catch it earlier.
